summary: Vale S.A. filed a Form 6-K containing a Proposal and Proxy Statement for an Extraordinary General Meeting scheduled for July 22, 2026. The agenda includes three items: removal of board member Daniel André Stieler, election of a replacement if removal is approved, and election of the Chairman. The filing is a routine governance circular seeking shareholder votes on board composition, without any special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, or activist campaign. No price, premium, or deal terms are present. This is a standard foreign private issuer report of a shareholder meeting.
